scope_of_C: The v10 simple helical quotient completed with the standard spacelike Hadamard image state and point-split topological RSET. This is not a no-go for every CBSSL law or every nonstandard chronology prescription.

sa_extension.reason: Existing SA work lacks one global positive Hadamard state across shells, RN horizons, and the timelike-singularity boundary; the helical image sector also diverges as the orbit becomes null.

communication.reason: Positive D_past in the isolated Z2 signal sector does not override failed global-state, RSET, backreaction, regularity, and stability gates.

sacrificed_physics: Global hyperbolicity / ordinary initial-value QFT: past advance requires a timelike quotient outside the safe spacelike Hadamard image branch.
Standard linear quantum dynamics: CBSSL is explicitly a new non-affine chronology-sector selection law, not derived from standard QFT or a microscopic QG theory.
Full SA quantum-state/boundary completion: the RN timelike-singularity self-adjoint boundary and two-horizon regularity are unresolved.
Dynamical topology formation: the helical identification/handle is imposed rather than evolved from ordinary Cauchy data with finite mouths and apparatus.
Controlled semiclassical expansion: r0~101.5 lP, xi=-10000, limited printed RSET coefficient precision, higher-curvature/stress-fluctuation corrections unsolved.
Dynamical/stochastic stability: expectation-value backreaction in a restricted static ansatz does not control nonspherical, time-dependent, or RSET-fluctuation instabilities.
